answer: New identities join one global glacier queue on the public ivory board: only 100 graduate to paid work each epoch. Each identity from one funding wallet pushes the next back by 25 places times the square of its position, so the 1st fake waits one epoch while the 10th waits 25, paying 1 POA upkeep per waiting epoch. While waiting each must answer a random raven call — re-perform a past job live within an hour — or lose its place and a 5 POA bond. Queue order is public, so anyone can verify the pushback.
